title: RNAflow 0.7.0 (2026-07-01)
text: Inference vs. shrinkage separation (fixes GSEA crash). run_deseq2() now always takes stat / pvalue / padj unshrunken Wald test overlays shrunken log2FoldChange / lfcSE. Transparent shrinkage fallback. apeglm used given contrast (coefficient model), switch normal shrinkage now reported rather silent. WGCNA soft-power fallback. scale-free fit reach target (common small sample sizes), wgcna_pick_power() falls back WGCNA’s sample-size-based default flags plot. Reproducibility. R-script export records contrast’s covariates; HTML report now embeds full sessionInfo(). clarify downstream (enrichment/WGCNA) steps use default parameters.
